name: Desktop Chess Game
description: A playable chess game with graphical board, piece movement, and full rule validation
goal: Enable players to enjoy a complete game of chess with full standard chess rules, move validation, and game-state tracking
requirements: Render an 8x8 chessboard with standard starting position (white on rank 1, black on rank 8)
Display all 16 pieces per side with correct starting placement
Implement piece movement via drag-and-drop or click-to-move selection
Validate all standard chess moves (pawn push/capture, castling, en passant, promotion)
Prevent illegal moves (piece-specific rules, can't move through other pieces, can't capture own pieces)
Display current turn indicator (whose turn to move)
Detect check condition and warn the player
Allow players to request draw or resign
Display move history with algebraic notation
Allow undo last move for both players
targetAudience: Desktop users (Windows, macOS, Linux) who enjoy chess and want a local, offline-capable game
constraints: Cross-platform desktop app (Electron recommended for compatibility)
Must be fully playable offline with no network requirements
Performance requirement: moves must respond within 100ms
No AI or external chess engine (human vs human only)
Tech stack: TypeScript + React for UI, Electron for desktop
Board must be visually clear with high contrast between light/dark squares
Mobile/touch support optional but considered a plus
